en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I can see a spiral staircase...
It looks pretty long.

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this another <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate lab<CLT=cltMIND>?
Then, it must be...
Finally, it looks like this is my research lab!

Nyeeeh...those stairs were long and such a pain.
I'm tired... Someone give me a piggyback ride.

They made us climb all these stairs just for
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Astronaut<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab?

What do you mean "just"? This is the main stage,
and it's finally been revealed!

I-I'm tired... Hey...someone...give me 
a piggyback ride.

Anyway, let's go inside. There might be
something useful in here...probably.

What do you mean "probably"!?
It's gotta be full of super important stuff!

Hey! Isn't anyone gonna give me 
a piggyback ride!?

Shut up! I'm not gonna give you 
a piggyback ride!

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a pretty long staircase.
Where does it lead?

<CLT=cltMIND>...I feel as if there's something there.
It's best to be cautious.

<CLT=cltMIND>Obeying these announcements makes me
feel like a character in a story...
